snippet.title: SOG: Vietnam - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Head to Vietnam as a lone SOG operative. Gear up, upgrade your skills, and explore the danger-filled jungles. Complete the missions assigned by your country and eliminate enemies using napalm and artillery in a brutal, tactical, turn-based 2D roguelite - SOG: Vietnam!

Download demo and add to wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288050?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=demo
